data.text: I’ll commit to 10 tons this month. Keeping this lake healthy means keeping our families’ livelihoods secure. Luke, you shouldn’t have to sit out more than anyone else, so let’s write down a five-month rotation: each of us gets two 15-ton months, two 10-ton months, and one zero-catch month. That gives everyone 50 tons over the cycle while keeping our monthly total at 50. John, does that work for you, including a firm 15-ton catch this month?
